Question:
What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id as root_id,
        p.id as current_id,
        1 as multiplier
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id as current_id,
        pt.multiplier * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(total_leaf_quantity) as average_total_quantity
FROM (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(multiplier) as total_leaf_quantity
    FROM packaging_tree
    WHERE current_id IN (501, 502)
    GROUP BY root_id
)

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        id AS root_id,
        id AS current_id,
        1 AS depth,
        1 AS multiplier
    FROM packaging
    WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations GROUP BY contains_id)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        pt.depth + 1,
        pt.multiplier * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT id AS current_id
    FROM packaging
    WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations GROUP BY packaging_id)
),
final_combinations AS (
    SELECT pt.root_id, SUM(pt.multiplier) as total_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN leaf_items li ON pt.current_id = li.current_id
    WHERE pt.depth > 1
    GROUP BY pt.root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_qty) as average_total_quantity
FROM final_combinations

WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        packaging_id AS root_id,
        contains_id AS current_id,
        qty::DECIMAL(10,2) AS path_multiplier
    FROM packaging_relations
    WHERE packaging_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)

    SELECT 
        h.root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        h.path_multiplier * pr.qty::DECIMAL(10,2) AS path_multiplier
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.current_id = pr.packaging_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) AS average_total_quantity
FROM (
    SELECT root_id, SUM(path_multiplier) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM hierarchy
    WHERE current_id IN (501, 502)
    GROUP BY root_id
)

WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS root_id,
        p.id AS current_id,
        0 AS depth,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)

        h.root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        h.depth + 1,

    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.current_id = pr.packaging_id
),

    SELECT 
        h.root_id,
        p.id AS leaf_id,
        h.cumulative_qty AS total_qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging p ON h.current_id = p.id
    WHERE p.id IN (SELECT id FROM packaging WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations))
),
total_by_root AS (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(total_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM leaf_level
    GROUP BY root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) AS average_total_quantity
FROM total_by_root
